title: Impact of a Culturally Tailored Educational Intervention on Human Papillomavirus Knowledge and Vaccination Intentions Among Women in Saudi Arabia: Quasi-Experimental Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted infections worldwide. Despite the availability of effective vaccines, uptake remains suboptimal in many settings, including Saudi Arabia, where cultural sensitivities, limited awareness, and vaccine hesitancy have been documented. Educational interventions grounded in behavioral theory, such as the information-motivation-behavioral skills (IMB) model, can help address informational and motivational barriers to HPV vaccination. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an educational intervention in improving HPV vaccination decision-making among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. METHODS: A quasi-experimental design (pretest-posttest with a control group) was used among women attending primary health care centers in the Northern Border Region of Saudi Arabia. A total of 380 participants, 190 in the control group and 190 in the intervention group, completed surveys at baseline (T1), 1-week post intervention (T2), and a 3-month follow-up (T3), assessing HPV-related knowledge, health awareness, attitudes, and vaccination intentions. The educational intervention consisted of a culturally adapted, evidence-based, 45-minute interactive group session delivered in primary health care centers. RESULTS: Study retention was excellent (380/389, 97.7%). At the 3-month follow-up, intervention participants demonstrated medium to large effect size improvements compared with controls: knowledge (adjusted β=0.84, 95% CI 0.53-1.15; P .10), suggesting consistent intervention effects across demographic characteristics. CONCLUSIONS: This culturally tailored educational intervention was effective in improving HPV-related knowledge, attitudes, health awareness, and vaccination intentions among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. Given the well-documented intention-behavior gap in vaccination uptake, future research should incorporate verified vaccine initiation and completion outcomes, along with longer follow-up, to assess whether enhanced intentions translate into actual vaccine uptake.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒,HPV)是全球最常见的性传播感染之一。尽管有有效的疫苗(抗病毒药物)可用,但在许多地区,包括沙特阿拉伯,其接种率仍不理想,这与文化敏感性、有限的认知以及疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种犹豫有关。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在沙特阿拉伯北方边境地区初级卫生保健中心参加活动的女性中,采用准实验设计(基线前测-后测与对照组)。共有380名参与者,其中190名在对照组,190名在干预组,分别在基线(T1)、干预后1周(T2)和随访3个月(T3)时完成调查,评估与HPV相关的知识、健康意识、态度和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿。
elements_zh.methods: 教育干预包括一项文化适应性、基于证据的、45分钟的互动小组课程,由初级卫生保健中心提供。
elements_zh.main_results: Study retention was excellent (380/389, 97.7%). At the 3-month follow-up, intervention participants demonstrated medium to large effect size improvements compared with controls: knowledge (adjusted β=0.84, 95% CI 0.53-1.15; P .10), suggesting consistent intervention effects across demographic characteristics.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项文化定制的教育干预在提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识、态度、健康意识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿方面是有效的。基于行为理论的教育干预,如信息-动机-行为技能(IMB)模型,有助于解决HPV 疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)的信息和动机障碍。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于在疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)接种中已记录的意愿与行为之间的差距,未来的研究应纳入已验证的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动和完成结果,并进行更长时间的随访,以评估增强的意愿是否转化为实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种行为。本研究提供了证据,表明文化定制的教育干预可以提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的局限性。由于采用准实验设计,并且主要基于自我报告的结果,而未验证实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动或完成情况,因此该研究的证据强度中等。

title_zh: 在沙特阿拉伯女性中,文化定制的教育干预对人乳头瘤病毒知识和疫苗接种意愿的影响:准实验研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted infections worldwide. Despite the availability of effective vaccines, uptake remains suboptimal in many settings, including Saudi Arabia, where cultural sensitivities, limited awareness, and vaccine hesitancy have been documented. Educational interventions grounded in behavioral theory, such as the information-motivation-behavioral skills (IMB) model, can help address informational and motivational barriers to HPV vaccination. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the impact of an educational intervention in improving HPV vaccination decision-making among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. METHODS: A quasi-experimental design (pretest-posttest with a control group) was used among women attending primary health care centers in the Northern Border Region of Saudi Arabia. A total of 380 participants, 190 in the control group and 190 in the intervention group, completed surveys at baseline (T1), 1-week post intervention (T2), and a 3-month follow-up (T3), assessing HPV-related knowledge, health awareness, attitudes, and vaccination intentions. The educational intervention consisted of a culturally adapted, evidence-based, 45-minute interactive group session delivered in primary health care centers. RESULTS: Study retention was excellent (380/389, 97.7%). At the 3-month follow-up, intervention participants demonstrated medium to large effect size improvements compared with controls: knowledge (adjusted β=0.84, 95% CI 0.53-1.15; P .10), suggesting consistent intervention effects across demographic characteristics. CONCLUSIONS: This culturally tailored educational intervention was effective in improving HPV-related knowledge, attitudes, health awareness, and vaccination intentions among women in Northern Saudi Arabia. Given the well-documented intention-behavior gap in vaccination uptake, future research should incorporate verified vaccine initiation and completion outcomes, along with longer follow-up, to assess whether enhanced intentions translate into actual vaccine uptake.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒,HPV)是全球最常见的性传播感染之一。尽管有有效的疫苗(抗病毒药物)可用,但在许多地区,包括沙特阿拉伯,其接种率仍不理想,这与文化敏感性、有限的认知以及疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种犹豫有关。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在沙特阿拉伯北方边境地区初级卫生保健中心参加活动的女性中,采用准实验设计(基线前测-后测与对照组)。共有380名参与者,其中190名在对照组,190名在干预组,分别在基线(T1)、干预后1周(T2)和随访3个月(T3)时完成调查,评估与HPV相关的知识、健康意识、态度和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿。
analysis_zh.methods: 教育干预包括一项文化适应性、基于证据的、45分钟的互动小组课程,由初级卫生保健中心提供。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项文化定制的教育干预在提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识、态度、健康意识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿方面是有效的。基于行为理论的教育干预,如信息-动机-行为技能(IMB)模型,有助于解决HPV 疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)的信息和动机障碍。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于在疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)接种中已记录的意愿与行为之间的差距,未来的研究应纳入已验证的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动和完成结果,并进行更长时间的随访,以评估增强的意愿是否转化为实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种行为。本研究提供了证据,表明文化定制的教育干预可以提高沙特阿拉伯北方女性对HPV相关知识和疫苗接种(抗病毒药物接种)意愿的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的局限性。由于采用准实验设计,并且主要基于自我报告的结果,而未验证实际的疫苗(抗病毒药物)接种启动或完成情况,因此该研究的证据强度中等。

title: Study of Human Papillomavirus Vaccine-Related Social Media Content Across Eight Social Media Platforms: Scoping Review of Communication Content, Information Sources, and Analytical Approaches.
abstract: Abstract Background Social media has become an important channel for health information dissemination and public discussion of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination. Previous reviews have examined social media and HPV vaccination, often focusing on single platforms, broader HPV-related topics, or the potential effects on knowledge, leaving limited cross-platform synthesis specifically focused on HPV vaccine–related communication content, information sources, and analytical approaches. Objective This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize peer-reviewed studies examining HPV vaccine–related social media content, with particular attention to communication content, information sources, and methodological characteristics. Methods Following the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews) guidelines, we searched PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus on June 10, 2026. Backward and forward citation searches were completed on July 17, 2026. We included peer-reviewed English-language original studies published between 2006 and 2026 that analyzed HPV vaccine–related communication content on social media. Data were charted using a structured extraction form and synthesized descriptively. No formal risk-of-bias assessment was conducted. Results A total of 50 studies published between 2012 and 2026 met the eligibility criteria. Eight social media platforms were represented, with X (formerly Twitter; X Corp) most frequently studied, followed by Weibo (Weibo Corporation), and YouTube (Google LLC). HPV vaccine–related communication content was synthesized into 5 categories: risk- and concern-oriented, benefit- and prevention-oriented, misinformation- and distrust-related, experiential and narrative, and practical and policy-related communication. Across studies, prevention and benefit messages coexisted with safety concerns, side effects, access barriers, misinformation, distrust, and personal narratives. Personal accounts were often associated with experiential narratives or negative sentiment, whereas professional sources were less common but generally provided more informative or higher-quality content. Analytical approaches included content analysis, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and network analysis, but theoretical frameworks were applied in only a minority of studies. Conclusions The evidence was limited by heterogeneity in platforms, sampling strategies, data collection periods, coding schemes, and analytical methods, limiting direct comparison across studies. Because most studies analyzed publicly available social media content, this review could not determine individual-level exposure, interpretation, vaccination intention, or vaccine uptake. Overall, HPV vaccine discourse cannot be adequately understood through sentiment polarity alone. This review provides a cross-platform, content-focused synthesis of how HPV vaccine–related social media communication has been studied. Unlike previous reviews, this review clarifies how HPV vaccine–related content has been described, who generates it, and which methods have been used to analyze it. These findings support theory-informed, platform-sensitive research and may inform public health communication strategies, including evidence-based education, transparent risk communication, credible source engagement, narrative-informed messaging, misinformation monitoring, and improved information quality.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本范围审查旨在绘制和综合分析HPV 疫苗相关的社交媒体内容的研究,特别关注沟通内容、信息来源和方法学特征。本综述关注人乳头瘤病毒、HPV类型和明确的HPV相关疾病,包括宫颈上皮内瘤变、HPV相关的宫颈癌、HPV相关的肛门癌、HPV相关的口咽癌、生殖器疣和HPV感染。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据范围审查的PRISMA-ScR指南,我们在2026年6月10日搜索了PubMed、Web of Science、MEDLINE、Embase和Scopus。纳入了2006年至2026年间发表的英语原创同行评审研究,这些研究分析了社交媒体上的HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容。数据使用结构化提取表进行记录,并进行了描述性综合。未进行正式的偏倚风险评估。在2026年7月17日完成了引文追溯和引文追踪。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容被综合为5类:风险和担忧导向的、益处和预防导向的、错误信息和不信任相关的、经验性和叙述性的以及实用性和政策导向的沟通。在研究中,预防和益处信息与安全担忧、副作用、访问障碍、错误信息、不信任和个人叙述共存。个人账户通常与经验性叙述或负面情绪相关,而专业来源较少但通常提供了更具有信息性或高质量的内容。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据受到平台、采样策略、数据收集时期、编码方案和分析方法的异质性限制,限制了研究间的直接比较。大多数研究分析了公开可用的社交媒体内容,因此本综述无法确定个体暴露、解释、HPV意图或HPV 疫苗的接受度。本综述还指出,仅通过情感极性无法充分捕捉HPV 疫苗讨论的复杂性。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现支持理论导向、平台敏感的研究,并可能指导公共卫生沟通策略,包括基于证据的教育、透明的风险沟通、可信来源的参与、叙述导向的信息传递、错误信息监测和提高信息质量。

analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HPV vaccine–related communication content was synthesized into 5 categories: risk- and concern-oriented, benefit- and prevention-oriented, misinformation- and distrust-related, experiential and narrative, and practical and policy-related communication. title_zh: 研究人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗相关的社交媒体内容:八种社交媒体平台的范围审查,关注沟通内容、信息来源和分析方法。
source_body_en: Abstract Background Social media has become an important channel for health information dissemination and public discussion of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination. Previous reviews have examined social media and HPV vaccination, often focusing on single platforms, broader HPV-related topics, or the potential effects on knowledge, leaving limited cross-platform synthesis specifically focused on HPV vaccine–related communication content, information sources, and analytical approaches. Objective This scoping review aimed to map and synthesize peer-reviewed studies examining HPV vaccine–related social media content, with particular attention to communication content, information sources, and methodological characteristics. Methods Following the PRISMA-ScR (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews) guidelines, we searched PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus on June 10, 2026. Backward and forward citation searches were completed on July 17, 2026. We included peer-reviewed English-language original studies published between 2006 and 2026 that analyzed HPV vaccine–related communication content on social media. Data were charted using a structured extraction form and synthesized descriptively. No formal risk-of-bias assessment was conducted. Results A total of 50 studies published between 2012 and 2026 met the eligibility criteria. Eight social media platforms were represented, with X (formerly Twitter; X Corp) most frequently studied, followed by Weibo (Weibo Corporation), and YouTube (Google LLC). HPV vaccine–related communication content was synthesized into 5 categories: risk- and concern-oriented, benefit- and prevention-oriented, misinformation- and distrust-related, experiential and narrative, and practical and policy-related communication. Across studies, prevention and benefit messages coexisted with safety concerns, side effects, access barriers, misinformation, distrust, and personal narratives. Personal accounts were often associated with experiential narratives or negative sentiment, whereas professional sources were less common but generally provided more informative or higher-quality content. Analytical approaches included content analysis, sentiment analysis, topic modeling, and network analysis, but theoretical frameworks were applied in only a minority of studies. Conclusions The evidence was limited by heterogeneity in platforms, sampling strategies, data collection periods, coding schemes, and analytical methods, limiting direct comparison across studies. Because most studies analyzed publicly available social media content, this review could not determine individual-level exposure, interpretation, vaccination intention, or vaccine uptake. Overall, HPV vaccine discourse cannot be adequately understood through sentiment polarity alone. This review provides a cross-platform, content-focused synthesis of how HPV vaccine–related social media communication has been studied. Unlike previous reviews, this review clarifies how HPV vaccine–related content has been described, who generates it, and which methods have been used to analyze it. These findings support theory-informed, platform-sensitive research and may inform public health communication strategies, including evidence-based education, transparent risk communication, credible source engagement, narrative-informed messaging, misinformation monitoring, and improved information quality.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本范围审查旨在绘制和综合分析HPV 疫苗相关的社交媒体内容的研究,特别关注沟通内容、信息来源和方法学特征。本综述关注人乳头瘤病毒、HPV类型和明确的HPV相关疾病,包括宫颈上皮内瘤变、HPV相关的宫颈癌、HPV相关的肛门癌、HPV相关的口咽癌、生殖器疣和HPV感染。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据范围审查的PRISMA-ScR指南,我们在2026年6月10日搜索了PubMed、Web of Science、MEDLINE、Embase和Scopus。纳入了2006年至2026年间发表的英语原创同行评审研究,这些研究分析了社交媒体上的HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容。数据使用结构化提取表进行记录,并进行了描述性综合。未进行正式的偏倚风险评估。在2026年7月17日完成了引文追溯和引文追踪。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: HPV 疫苗相关的沟通内容被综合为5类:风险和担忧导向的、益处和预防导向的、错误信息和不信任相关的、经验性和叙述性的以及实用性和政策导向的沟通。在研究中,预防和益处信息与安全担忧、副作用、访问障碍、错误信息、不信任和个人叙述共存。个人账户通常与经验性叙述或负面情绪相关,而专业来源较少但通常提供了更具有信息性或高质量的内容。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据受到平台、采样策略、数据收集时期、编码方案和分析方法的异质性限制,限制了研究间的直接比较。大多数研究分析了公开可用的社交媒体内容,因此本综述无法确定个体暴露、解释、HPV意图或HPV 疫苗的接受度。本综述还指出,仅通过情感极性无法充分捕捉HPV 疫苗讨论的复杂性。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 这些发现支持理论导向、平台敏感的研究,并可能指导公共卫生沟通策略,包括基于证据的教育、透明的风险沟通、可信来源的参与、叙述导向的信息传递、错误信息监测和提高信息质量。

title: Diagnostic accuracy of menstrual blood for human papillomavirus detection in cervical cancer screening: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: Cervical cancer is a major global health burden, disproportionately affecting women in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where access to traditional human papillomavirus (HPV) screening is limited. Menstrual blood (MB), a non-invasive and passively collectable biospecimen, may offer a culturally acceptable alternative. This review evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of MB-based high-risk HPV detection compared to clinician-collected cervical samples. METHODS: We included diagnostic accuracy studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating self-collected MB for high-risk HPV detection in asymptomatic women aged 25-65 years. Eligible studies reported sensitivity, specificity, or 2×2 data using clinician-collected cervical samples as the reference. We searched PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar up to July 7, 2025. Risk of bias was assessed via QUADAS-3, and a bivariate random-effects model estimated pooled sensitivity and specificity. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. RESULTS: Seven studies (n = 1,297 participants; 586 reference-positive, 711 reference-negative) met inclusion criteria. The pooled sensitivity and specificity of MB-based HPV testing were 0.86 (95% CI: 0.80-0.90) and 0.90 (95% CI: 0.72-0.97), respectively. The diagnostic odds ratio was 56 (95% CI: 19-166), and the area under the hierarchical SROC curve was 0.90 (95% CI: 0.87-0.92), indicating high overall diagnostic performance. However, high heterogeneity (I2 = 94%) and threshold effects were observed. No significant publication bias was detected (Deeks' p = 0.62). CONCLUSIONS: MB-based HPV testing demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy and emerges as a non-invasive alternative for cervical cancer screening, especially in underserved settings. Further validation in diverse populations is warranted.

source_records.title: Diagnostic accuracy of menstrual blood for human papillomavirus detection in cervical cancer screening: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
source_records.abstract: PURPOSE: Cervical cancer is a major global health burden, disproportionately affecting women in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where access to traditional human papillomavirus (HPV) screening is limited. Menstrual blood (MB), a non-invasive and passively collectable biospecimen, may offer a culturally acceptable alternative. This review evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of MB-based high-risk HPV detection compared to clinician-collected cervical samples. METHODS: We included diagnostic accuracy studies and randomized controlled trials (RCTs) evaluating self-collected MB for high-risk HPV detection in asymptomatic women aged 25-65 years. Eligible studies reported sensitivity, specificity, or 2×2 data using clinician-collected cervical samples as the reference. We searched PubMed, Embase, and Google Scholar up to July 7, 2025. Risk of bias was assessed via QUADAS-3, and a bivariate random-effects model estimated pooled sensitivity and specificity. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. RESULTS: Seven studies (n = 1,297 participants; 586 reference-positive, 711 reference-negative) met inclusion criteria. The pooled sensitivity and specificity of MB-based HPV testing were 0.86 (95% CI: 0.80-0.90) and 0.90 (95% CI: 0.72-0.97), respectively. The diagnostic odds ratio was 56 (95% CI: 19-166), and the area under the hierarchical SROC curve was 0.90 (95% CI: 0.87-0.92), indicating high overall diagnostic performance. However, high heterogeneity (I2 = 94%) and threshold effects were observed. No significant publication bias was detected (Deeks' p = 0.62). CONCLUSIONS: MB-based HPV testing demonstrates high diagnostic accuracy and emerges as a non-invasive alternative for cervical cancer screening, especially in underserved settings. Further validation in diverse populations is warranted.

abstract_zh: 目的:宫颈癌是全球主要的健康负担,尤其在低收入和中等收入国家(LMICs)中对女性影响更大,这些地区传统人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查的可及性有限。月经血(MB)作为一种非侵入性且可被动收集的生物样本,可能提供一种文化上可接受的替代方案。本综述评估了基于月经血的高危型HPV检测与由临床医生收集的宫颈样本相比的诊断准确性。方法:我们纳入了评估自取月经血用于高危型HPV检测的诊断准确性研究和随机对照试验(RCTs),研究对象为无症状的25-65岁女性。符合纳入标准的研究报告了使用临床医生收集的宫颈样本作为参考的敏感性、特异性或2×2数据。我们于2025年7月7日之前在PubMed、Embase和Google Scholar上进行了检索。偏倚风险通过QUADAS-3进行评估,采用双变量随机效应模型估计汇总敏感性和特异性。证据的确定性使用GRADE进行评估。结果:七项研究(n = 1,297名参与者;586名参考阳性,711名参考阴性)符合纳入标准。基于月经血的HPV检测的汇总敏感性和特异性分别为0.86(95% CI:0.80-0.90)和0.90(95% CI:0.72-0.97)。诊断比值比为56(95% CI:19-166),层次SROC曲线下的面积为0.90(95% CI:0.87-0.92),表明总体诊断性能较高。然而,观察到高度异质性(I2 = 94%)和阈值效应。未检测到显著的发表偏倚(Deeks' p = 0.62)。结论:基于月经血的HPV检测显示出高诊断准确性,并成为宫颈癌筛查的一种非侵入性替代方案,特别是在服务不足的地区。需要在多样化的群体中进一步验证。

title: PDS0101 With Pembrolizumab in HPV16-Positive Recurrent/Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma: A Phase 2 Nonrandomized Clinical Trial.
abstract: IMPORTANCE: The incidence of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16-positive) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is rising. Approved therapies offer a durable response to a minority of patients. OBJECTIVE: To determine the efficacy and safety of a therapeutic HPV16-targeted immunotherapy, PDS0101, in combination with pembrolizumab in participants with HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with separate evaluation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-naive and ICI-resistant cohorts. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: VERSATILE-002 was a phase 2, open-label, multicenter nonrandomized clinical trial conducted at 26 oncology centers from March 29, 2021, to May 15, 2025, across the US, UK, and Ireland using the Simon 2-stage optimal design. Efficacy analyses were performed on modified intent-to-treat (mITT) population; safety analyses included all participants who received 1 or more doses. Eighty-eight participants with histologically confirmed R/M HPV16-positive HNSCC were enrolled, of whom 87 (98.9%) received treatment and composed the safety population. Seventy five (85.2%) were in the mITT population used for efficacy analyses, of whom 53 (70.7%) were ICI-naive with a programmed cell death ligand 1 combined positive score of 1 or greater and 22 (29.3%) were ICI-resistant. EXPOSURES: Pembrolizumab (200 mg, intravenously, every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles) plus subcutaneous PDS0101 (5 scheduled doses per protocol). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary end point was objective response rate (ORR) per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1, by a masked independent central reviewer. Secondary end points included progression-free survival (PFS), median overall survival (mOS), and safety, with exploratory end points of duration of response, disease control rate, and response rates by programmed cell death ligand 1 status. RESULTS: Of the 75 patients in the mITT population, the mean (SD) age was 64.0 (8.3) years; 4 individuals (5%) were female and 71 (95%) were male; and 2 individuals (3%) were Asian, 1 (1%) was Black, 5 (7%) were Hispanic, and 71 (95%) were White. Among 53 ICI-naive participants in the mITT cohort, ORR by the central reviewer was 34.0%, median PFS was 5.3 months (95% CI, 2.10-9.00), and mOS was 39.3 months (95% CI, 23.90 to not evaluable). Among 22 ICI-resistant patients in the mITT cohort, no objective responses were observed and the primary end point (ORR by central reviewer) was not met, but mOS was 14.8 months (95% CI, 8.50-26.00). The treatment was well tolerated, with 13.8% experiencing grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The results of this nonrandomized clinical trial suggest that PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab showed antitumor activity in ICI-naive HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with favorable safety, response rates, and survival outcomes. The findings support further evaluation in a first-line setting. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04260126.

title_zh: PDS0101 与 Pembrolizumab 联合治疗 HPV16 阳性复发/转移性头颈鳞状细胞癌:2 期非随机临床试验。
source_body_en: IMPORTANCE: The incidence of human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16-positive) recurrent/metastatic (R/M) head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is rising. Approved therapies offer a durable response to a minority of patients. OBJECTIVE: To determine the efficacy and safety of a therapeutic HPV16-targeted immunotherapy, PDS0101, in combination with pembrolizumab in participants with HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with separate evaluation of immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI)-naive and ICI-resistant cohorts. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: VERSATILE-002 was a phase 2, open-label, multicenter nonrandomized clinical trial conducted at 26 oncology centers from March 29, 2021, to May 15, 2025, across the US, UK, and Ireland using the Simon 2-stage optimal design. Efficacy analyses were performed on modified intent-to-treat (mITT) population; safety analyses included all participants who received 1 or more doses. Eighty-eight participants with histologically confirmed R/M HPV16-positive HNSCC were enrolled, of whom 87 (98.9%) received treatment and composed the safety population. Seventy five (85.2%) were in the mITT population used for efficacy analyses, of whom 53 (70.7%) were ICI-naive with a programmed cell death ligand 1 combined positive score of 1 or greater and 22 (29.3%) were ICI-resistant. EXPOSURES: Pembrolizumab (200 mg, intravenously, every 3 weeks for up to 35 cycles) plus subcutaneous PDS0101 (5 scheduled doses per protocol). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary end point was objective response rate (ORR) per the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors, version 1.1, by a masked independent central reviewer. Secondary end points included progression-free survival (PFS), median overall survival (mOS), and safety, with exploratory end points of duration of response, disease control rate, and response rates by programmed cell death ligand 1 status. RESULTS: Of the 75 patients in the mITT population, the mean (SD) age was 64.0 (8.3) years; 4 individuals (5%) were female and 71 (95%) were male; and 2 individuals (3%) were Asian, 1 (1%) was Black, 5 (7%) were Hispanic, and 71 (95%) were White. Among 53 ICI-naive participants in the mITT cohort, ORR by the central reviewer was 34.0%, median PFS was 5.3 months (95% CI, 2.10-9.00), and mOS was 39.3 months (95% CI, 23.90 to not evaluable). Among 22 ICI-resistant patients in the mITT cohort, no objective responses were observed and the primary end point (ORR by central reviewer) was not met, but mOS was 14.8 months (95% CI, 8.50-26.00). The treatment was well tolerated, with 13.8% experiencing grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The results of this nonrandomized clinical trial suggest that PDS0101 plus pembrolizumab showed antitumor activity in ICI-naive HPV16-positive R/M HNSCC, with favorable safety, response rates, and survival outcomes. The findings support further evaluation in a first-line setting. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04260126.

title: Regulation and function of the HPV16 CircE7 RNA.
abstract: ABSTRACT High-risk human papillomaviruses (HPV), including HPV16, produce circular RNA that encompasses the E7 oncogene (circE7). CircE7 can be detected in HPV16-positive cells and tumors, is preferentially localized to the cytoplasm, is N 6 -methyladenosine (m 6 A)-modified, and can be translated into the E7 oncoprotein. Here, we explored the regulation and function of circE7. Mutation of m 6 A motifs flanking the backsplice junction revealed a single m 6 A motif to be essential for circE7 formation. Mutation of this m 6 A motif promoted linear splicing of the E6*I splice site (226^409), suggesting that linear and circular E7 splicing are inversely regulated. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the regulation and function of circE7 RNA produced by HPV16, as high-risk HPVs, including HPV16, must carefully control E6 and E7 protein production to maintain their oncogenic potential.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted using HPV16-positive cell lines and primary keratinocytes, with experiments involving mutation of m6A motifs and IRES-like sequences, as well as knockdown of m6A-binding proteins like YTHDC1.
analysis.methods: The researchers used qRT-PCR and BaseScope ISH to detect circE7 RNA, and generated an HPV16 genome with mutations in the circE7 m6A motif to assess its effects on viral replication and transformation.
analysis.main_results: Mutation of the m6A motif in circE7 was found to be essential for its formation, and also led to increased linear splicing of the E6*I isoform. Additionally, mutation of an IRES-like motif in circE7 significantly decreased E7 protein expression, while knockdown of YTHDC1 reduced both circE7 RNA and protein levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the regulation of circE7 and E6*I by m6A is a critical mechanism for HPV16 to control its infection and transformation of keratinocytes, highlighting a novel regulatory pathway in HPV biology.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of HPV16 pathogenesis, which could inform the development of targeted therapies or diagnostic tools for HPV-associated cancers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and cell line models, and the evidence is based on experimental manipulation rather than clinical outcomes, which suggests a moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the regulation and function of circE7 RNA in HPV16, revealing that m6A modification is essential for circE7 formation and inversely regulates linear splicing of E6*I. Mutation of the m6A motif also reduced E7 protein expression, while knockdown of YTHDC1 decreased both circE7 RNA and protein levels. These findings suggest that m6A-mediated regulation of circE7 and E6*I is critical for HPV16's ability to infect and transform keratinocytes, offering new insights into HPV biology. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform future research on HPV-associated cancers, though its reliance on in vitro models limits the strength of the evidence to moderate.

analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和细胞系模型,证据基于实验操作而不是临床结果,这表明对研究结果的可信度中等。

title: PCR-LbCas12a Assay for Genotyping of HPV 16 and 18.
abstract: CRISPR/Cas12a systems have been widely used in nucleic acid detection, because of their high specificity and trans-cleavage activity. We combined the specificity of CRISPR/Cas12a system with the sensitivity of PCR, to develop a new HPV detection assay with high specificity and sensitivity, called PCR-LbCas12a assay. Here, we pre-amplified almost all high-risk HPV genotypes with consensus primer (MY09/11) and added to new tubes containing HPV 16 or 18 CRISPR/Cas12a system for HPV genotyping. The LOD of PCR-LbCas12a for HPV16 or HPV18 DNA was 100 copies and 10 copies per reaction, respectively. In mixed samples of HPV 16 and HPV 18 DNA, PCR-LbCas12a assay could detect HPV16 DNA from samples containing 10 2 copies of HPV16 and 10 4 copies of HPV18. On the other hand, HPV18 DNA was detected from samples containing 10 3 copies of HPV16 and HPV18, respectively. Following validation with HPV-positive and HPV-negative cell lines (SiHa, HeLa, and C-33A), the PCR-LbCas12a assay was evaluated using 39 clinical samples previously characterized by type-specific qPCR. The assay demonstrated a sensitivity of 91.3 (95 CI 71.9-98.9) and a specificity of 100. The PCR-LbCas12a assay can discriminate the HPV 16 and HPV 18 genotypes, and holds great potential in simultaneous detection of most high-risk HPV genotypes including HPV 16 and HPV18.

title_zh: PCR-LbCas12a 检测用于 HPV 16 和 18 的基因分型。
source_body_en: CRISPR/Cas12a systems have been widely used in nucleic acid detection, because of their high specificity and trans-cleavage activity. We combined the specificity of CRISPR/Cas12a system with the sensitivity of PCR, to develop a new HPV detection assay with high specificity and sensitivity, called PCR-LbCas12a assay. Here, we pre-amplified almost all high-risk HPV genotypes with consensus primer (MY09/11) and added to new tubes containing HPV 16 or 18 CRISPR/Cas12a system for HPV genotyping. The LOD of PCR-LbCas12a for HPV16 or HPV18 DNA was 100 copies and 10 copies per reaction, respectively. In mixed samples of HPV 16 and HPV 18 DNA, PCR-LbCas12a assay could detect HPV16 DNA from samples containing 10 2 copies of HPV16 and 10 4 copies of HPV18. On the other hand, HPV18 DNA was detected from samples containing 10 3 copies of HPV16 and HPV18, respectively. Following validation with HPV-positive and HPV-negative cell lines (SiHa, HeLa, and C-33A), the PCR-LbCas12a assay was evaluated using 39 clinical samples previously characterized by type-specific qPCR. The assay demonstrated a sensitivity of 91.3 (95 CI 71.9-98.9) and a specificity of 100. The PCR-LbCas12a assay can discriminate the HPV 16 and HPV 18 genotypes, and holds great potential in simultaneous detection of most high-risk HPV genotypes including HPV 16 and HPV18.

title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS (HPV) INFECTION IN CARCINOGENESIS AND THE ROLE OF PROPHYLACTIC VACCINATION: A NARRATIVE REVIEW
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is among the most prevalent sexually transmitted pathogens worldwide and an established cause of both benign proliferative lesions and malignant neoplasms. This narrative review examines the role of HPV infection in carcinogenesis at the principal anatomical sites involved and evaluates the contribution of prophylactic vaccination to disease control. A structured search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted for English-language publications available up to August 2026, supplemented by current guidance from international health authorities. The evidence confirms a causal role for high-risk genotypes, principally HPV-16 and HPV-18, in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and in cancers of the cervix, vulva, vagina, penis, and anus, mediated by the E6 and E7 oncoproteins through inactivation of the p53 and retinoblastoma pathways. The strength of this association is markedly site-dependent: it is well established in the oropharynx, cervix, and anus, but remains equivocal in the oral cavity and larynx. In oropharyngeal carcinoma, HPV status is an independent prognostic factor and is incorporated into current staging. Vaccination substantially reduces infection, precancerous lesions, and cervical cancer incidence, with the greatest benefit among individuals immunized before sexual debut. Vaccination and organized screening are complementary rather than alternative strategies, and suboptimal uptake-as observed in Poland-remains the principal barrier to realizing the full preventive potential of available vaccines.
journal: International Journal of Innovative Technologies in Social Science

source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is among the most prevalent sexually transmitted pathogens worldwide and an established cause of both benign proliferative lesions and malignant neoplasms. This narrative review examines the role of HPV infection in carcinogenesis at the principal anatomical sites involved and evaluates the contribution of prophylactic vaccination to disease control. A structured search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted for English-language publications available up to August 2026, supplemented by current guidance from international health authorities. The evidence confirms a causal role for high-risk genotypes, principally HPV-16 and HPV-18, in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma and in cancers of the cervix, vulva, vagina, penis, and anus, mediated by the E6 and E7 oncoproteins through inactivation of the p53 and retinoblastoma pathways. The strength of this association is markedly site-dependent: it is well established in the oropharynx, cervix, and anus, but remains equivocal in the oral cavity and larynx. In oropharyngeal carcinoma, HPV status is an independent prognostic factor and is incorporated into current staging. Vaccination substantially reduces infection, precancerous lesions, and cervical cancer incidence, with the greatest benefit among individuals immunized before sexual debut. Vaccination and organized screening are complementary rather than alternative strategies, and suboptimal uptake-as observed in Poland-remains the principal barrier to realizing the full preventive potential of available vaccines.

abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是全世界最流行的性传播病原体之一,也是良性增殖性病变和恶性肿瘤的既定原因。这篇叙述性综述探讨了 HPV 感染在主要解剖部位癌变中的作用,并评估了预防性药物 疫苗接种 对疾病控制的贡献。对 PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus 和 Web of Science 进行了结构化检索,查找截至 2026 年 8 月可用的英文出版物,并辅以国际卫生当局的最新指南。证据证实高危基因型(主要是 HPV-16 和 HPV-18)在口咽鳞状细胞癌以及子宫颈、外阴、阴道、阴茎和肛门癌症中的因果作用,由 E6 和 E7 癌蛋白通过 p53 和视网膜母细胞瘤途径失活介导。这种关联的强度明显取决于部位:它在口咽、子宫颈和肛门中已得到很好的建立,但在口腔和喉中仍然模棱两可。在口咽癌中,HPV 状态是一个独立的预后因素,并已纳入当前的分期中。疫苗接种 显着减少感染、癌前病变和 宫颈癌 发病率,在首次性行为前免疫的个体中获益最大。疫苗接种 和有组织的筛查是互补而非替代策略,而在波兰观察到的次优吸收仍然是实现现有 疫苗 全面预防潜力的主要障碍。

title: Partial sequence of L1 gene in HPV 16 and HPV 18 isolated from head-neck squamous cell carcinoma tissues in Bangladesh.
abstract: ABSTRACT Human papillomavirus is one of the most crucial determinants responsible for the progression of head-neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). Here, we report partial L1 gene sequences of two high-risk etiological agents, HPV-16 and HPV-18, extracted through biopsies from multiple head-neck tissue regions of HNSCC patients in Bangladesh.

title: Rationale and design of a clinical trial of a reduced dosing schedule for the nonavalent human papillomavirus vaccine in women living with HIV: The NOVA-HIV study.
abstract: Virtually all cases of cervical cancer are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV). Women and people with a cervix living with HIV (women with HIV) are disproportionately impacted by cervical cancer; they experience higher rates of HPV infection and increased susceptibility to persistent HPV infection than women without HIV. HPV vaccination is highly effective for prevention of cervical cancer, and the World Health Organization currently recommends a one or two-dose HPV vaccination schedule for immunocompetent females. Although the approved nonavalent HPV (9vHPV) vaccine is highly safe, immunogenic, and efficacious in those without HIV, there are very few data in women with HIV. To address this knowledge gap, the NOVA-HIV study is designed as a Canadian multicenter, observer-blind, randomized, phase IV clinical trial of the 9vHPV vaccine in women with HIV aged 18-45 years. The primary objective is to determine whether peak anti-HPV16/18 geometric mean titers (GMTs) after two doses of 9vHPV vaccine are non-inferior to peak anti-HPV16/18 GMTs after three doses. The trial will enroll 275 women with HIV from 11 sites across five Canadian provinces. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive the 9vHPV vaccine at the routine schedule (0/2/6 months) or extended schedule (0/6/12 months). Over 24 months, participants attend six or seven visits, where clinical data, blood, and vaginal samples are collected. Data generated could support the implementation of reduced-dose schedules in women with HIV, making vaccination more feasible, contributing to the elimination of cervical cancer, and accelerating global health equity.

Although the approved nonavalent HPV (9vHPV) vaccine is highly safe, immunogenic, and efficacious in those without HIV, there are very few data in women with HIV. To address this knowledge gap, the NOVA-HIV study is designed as a Canadian multicenter, observer-blind, randomized, phase IV clinical trial of the 9vHPV vaccine in women with HIV aged 18-45 years. The primary objective is to determine whether peak anti-HPV16/18 geometric mean titers (GMTs) after two doses of 9vHPV vaccine are non-inferior to peak anti-HPV16/18 GMTs after three doses. The trial will enroll 275 women with HIV from 11 sites across five Canadian provinces. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive the 9vHPV vaccine at the routine schedule (0/2/6 months) or extended schedule (0/6/12 months). Over 24 months, participants attend six or seven visits, where clinical data, blood, and vaginal samples are collected. Data generated could support the implementation of reduced-dose schedules in women with HIV, making vaccination more feasible, contributing to the elimination of cervical cancer, and accelerating global health equity.

title: Local carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil in women positive for human papillomavirus: a prospective observational study
abstract: Background: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infections with normal or low-grade cervical cytology are generally managed through observation because many infections clear spontaneously. However, persistent infection, particularly in women over 35 years of age, may increase the risk of progression and lead to prolonged surveillance, repeated examinations and patient anxiety. This study evaluates the effectiveness of local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil (Colpofix®) in achieving negativization of high-risk (HR) human papillomavirus (HPV) in a Spanish population of women with HR-HPV positivity. Methods: This prospective, non-randomized controlled, multi-centre study enrolled 533 women aged 25–65 with HR-HPV and normal cytology, atypical squamous cells of undetermined significance or low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. Conducted in real clinical settings, it involved a 3-month treatment or ‘wait-and-see’ approach, with final follow-up at 6 months. Statistical analysis included various tests such as the Mann– Whitney test, Fisher’s exact test and Pearson’s χ2 test. Results: At 6 months, HR-HPV negativity was observed in 50.1% of treated patients compared with 24.0% in the observation group (p<0.0001). Higher clearance rates were recorded across all HR-HPV genotypes. For HPV16, negativization occurred in 50.7% of treated patients versus 9.2% of controls (p=0.0291). Resolution of cervical ectopy was more frequent in the treatment group (42.6% versus 11.5%, p<0.0001). No adverse events were reported. Conclusions: Local treatment with carboxymethyl β-glucan and polycarbophil was associated with higher rates of HR-HPV negativization and ectopy resolution compared with observation alone at 6-month follow-up, supporting its use as a management option, particularly in women over 35 years of age. title: Human Papillomavirus Vaccination as the Basis for Cervical Cancer Prevention: Current Status and Prospects in the Kyrgyz Republic
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary etiological factor responsible for the development of cervical cancer and several other anogenital malignancies. According to the World Health Organization, more than 95% of cervical cancer cases are associated with persistent infection caused by high-risk HPV types. Currently, HPV vaccination is recognized as the most effective method for the primary prevention of cervical cancer and has been incorporated into national immunization programs in many countries worldwide. International experience has demonstrated a substantial reduction in the prevalence of HPV infection, high-grade cervical intraepithelial lesions, and invasive cervical cancer among vaccinated populations. The aim of this study was to analyze current evidence regarding HPV vaccination as an effective strategy for cervical cancer prevention and to assess the prospects for developing immunization programs in the Kyrgyz Republic. A review of national and international scientific literature, regulatory documents, and official statistical reports related to HPV prevention and vaccination was conducted. Data from the World Health Organization, the International Agency for Research on Cancer, and the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic were analyzed. HPV vaccination was found to be a safe and highly effective method for preventing HPV-associated diseases. Analysis of international experience demonstrated a significant reduction in the prevalence of oncogenic HPV types, high-grade cervical lesions, and cervical cancer incidence following the implementation of large-scale vaccination programs. However, various organizational, social, and informational barriers continue to limit the effectiveness of immunization programs in a number of countries, including the Kyrgyz Republic. Expanding HPV vaccination coverage represents one of the most promising strategies for cervical cancer prevention. Further development and strengthening of immunization programs may substantially reduce the incidence of and mortality from HPV-associated diseases among the female population of the Kyrgyz Republic.

title_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种作为宫颈癌预防的基础:吉尔吉斯共和国的现状和前景
source_body_en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary etiological factor responsible for the development of cervical cancer and several other anogenital malignancies. According to the World Health Organization, more than 95% of cervical cancer cases are associated with persistent infection caused by high-risk HPV types. Currently, HPV vaccination is recognized as the most effective method for the primary prevention of cervical cancer and has been incorporated into national immunization programs in many countries worldwide. International experience has demonstrated a substantial reduction in the prevalence of HPV infection, high-grade cervical intraepithelial lesions, and invasive cervical cancer among vaccinated populations. The aim of this study was to analyze current evidence regarding HPV vaccination as an effective strategy for cervical cancer prevention and to assess the prospects for developing immunization programs in the Kyrgyz Republic. A review of national and international scientific literature, regulatory documents, and official statistical reports related to HPV prevention and vaccination was conducted. Data from the World Health Organization, the International Agency for Research on Cancer, and the Ministry of Health of the Kyrgyz Republic were analyzed. HPV vaccination was found to be a safe and highly effective method for preventing HPV-associated diseases. Analysis of international experience demonstrated a significant reduction in the prevalence of oncogenic HPV types, high-grade cervical lesions, and cervical cancer incidence following the implementation of large-scale vaccination programs. However, various organizational, social, and informational barriers continue to limit the effectiveness of immunization programs in a number of countries, including the Kyrgyz Republic. Expanding HPV vaccination coverage represents one of the most promising strategies for cervical cancer prevention. Further development and strengthening of immunization programs may substantially reduce the incidence of and mortality from HPV-associated diseases among the female population of the Kyrgyz Republic.

title: A novel approach to HPV16 VLP construction and production with improved accessibility and particle sorting potential
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV), a member of the Papillomaviridae family, infects a broad range of animal hosts and is responsible for the majority of cervical cancers and a substantial proportion of oropharyngeal cancers. Current treatment strategies for HPV-associated cervical disease depend largely on disease stage, with preinvasive and early invasive lesions commonly managed through surgical excision or radiation. Additionally, more advanced cases often require chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or combination regimens. Prophylactic vaccination remains the most effective preventive approach, and currently available vaccines, including Gardasil, Gardasil-9, and Cervarix, rely on L1-based virus-like particles (VLPs) to induce protective immunity. At the same time, increasing interest has emerged in the use of nanomaterials and viral capsids as platforms for targeted drug and gene delivery, alongside the development of higher-throughput methods for nanoparticle and viral characterization. Modified HPV capsids have shown promise for cell-specific targeting and more efficient cargo delivery with reduced off-target cytotoxicity. In this study, the HPV16 structural proteins L1 and L2 were fused to the N- and C-terminal halves of the Venus fluorophore, respectively, using a specially designed linker intended to preserve capsid assembly while reducing VLP aggregation associated with current production methods. The resulting bimolecular fluorescence complementation (BiFC)-based VLPs demonstrated reduced aggregation and improved total particle yield. In addition, the particles generated a detectable YFP signal, supporting fluorescence-based monitoring of VLP assembly and providing a potential basis for high-throughput particle characterization and sorting. This intrinsic fluorescent signal may also reduce reliance on separately packaged reporter constructs for downstream analysis.

abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 是乳头瘤病毒科的成员,可感染多种动物 宿主,并导致大多数 宫颈癌 和相当大比例的口咽癌。目前针对 HPV 相关宫颈疾病的 治疗 策略在很大程度上取决于疾病阶段,浸润前和早期浸润性病变通常通过手术切除或放射治疗。此外,更晚期的病例通常需要化疗、免疫疗法或联合疗法。预防性 疫苗接种 仍然是最有效的预防方法,目前可用的 疫苗,包括 Gardasil、Gardasil-9 和 Cervarix,依靠基于 L1 的病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 来诱导保护性免疫。与此同时,人们对使用纳米材料和病毒衣壳作为靶向药物和基因递送的平台越来越感兴趣,同时开发了用于纳米颗粒和病毒表征的高通量方法。修饰的 HPV 衣壳已显示出细胞特异性靶向和更有效的货物递送以及减少脱靶细胞毒性的前景。在这项研究中,使用专门设计的接头将 HPV16 结构蛋白 L1 和 L2 分别融合到金星荧光团的 N 端和 C 端,旨在保留衣壳组装,同时减少与当前生产方法相关的 VLP 聚集。由此产生的基于双分子荧光互补 (BiFC) 的 VLP 表现出聚集减少和总颗粒产量提高。此外,颗粒产生可检测的 YFP 信号,支持基于荧光的 VLP 组装监测,并为高通量颗粒表征和分选提供潜在基础。这种内在的荧光信号还可以减少下游分析对单独包装的报告构建体的依赖。

title: Distribution of high-risk Human Papillomavirus genotypes in cervical specimen from women using real-time PCR (Abbott m2000), a retrospective analysis over five years at Centre Pasteur du Cameroun
abstract: Abstract Background The human papillomavirus (high-risk, HR-HPV) is the leading cause of nearly all cervical cancers, whose burden remains particularly high in sub-Saharan Africa. This study aimed to describe the prevalence and distribution of HR-HPV genotypes among patients referred to the Centre Pasteur du Cameroun (CPC) between 2021 and 2025, and to assess the association between age and the genotype identified. Methods Analytical cross-sectional study conducted on electronic records from the CPC laboratory information system (LIS), from January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2025. Qualitative detection of HR-HPV was performed on patients' cervical samples by real-time PCR (Abbott m2000), detecting 14 genotypes: 16, 18, and twelve other high-risk genotypes grouped together (31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 68). Analyses were performed using R version 4.0.5, with a chi-square test to assess the association between categorized age and genotype, the significance threshold being set at p

analysis.methods: The methods involved reviewing and synthesizing the 2025 recommendations from the Enduring Consensus Cervical Cancer Screening and Management Guidelines Committee, which included evaluating evidence on HPV screening and self-collected vaginal samples for their efficacy in detecting HPV-associated diseases.
analysis.main_results: The study reported that HPV screening using self-collected vaginal samples is recommended as an effective method for detecting high-risk HPV types associated with cervical cancer, with specific emphasis on HPV16 and HPV18.

analysis.summary_en: This study summarizes the 2025 recommendations on human papillomavirus (HPV) screening and self-collected vaginal samples, emphasizing their role in cervical cancer prevention. The research question focused on addressing the need for effective and accessible screening methods for HPV-associated diseases. The study design involved reviewing guidelines from the Enduring Consensus Cervical Cancer Screening and Management Guidelines Committee. The methods included synthesizing evidence on the efficacy of self-collected vaginal samples for HPV detection. The main results indicated that self-collected vaginal samples are recommended for HPV screening, particularly for high-risk types like HPV16 and HPV18. The authors interpreted these findings as supporting the use of self-collected samples to improve screening adherence. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform public health strategies for cervical cancer prevention. However, the evidence is based on guidelines and may have moderate strength due to the lack of original data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在总结2025年关于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查和自行采集阴道样本的建议,以解决有效的宫颈癌预防策略的科学和公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会 2025 年建议的总结,重点是 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 筛查和在 宫颈癌 预防背景下自行采集的阴道样本。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及审查和综合持久共识 宫颈癌 筛查和管理指南委员会的 2025 年建议,其中包括评估 HPV 筛查和自行收集的阴道样本在检测 HPV 相关疾病方面的功效的证据。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,建议使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查,作为检测与 宫颈癌 相关的 高危型HPV 类型的有效方法,特别强调 HPV16 和 HPV18。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为支持使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查,强调了它们在提高可及性和遵守 宫颈癌 筛查方案方面的作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以通过推广使用自行采集的阴道样本进行 HPV 筛查来为公共卫生策略提供信息,这可能会加强不同人群的 宫颈癌 预防工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于现有指南的总结,这可能会限制分析的深度,但由于其与既定建议的一致性,证据被认为是中等的。

title: Association Between High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Infection and Vaginal Microbiota Dysbiosis Among Women
abstract: Background: Cervical cancer is still one of the major causes of cancer-related deaths among women in India. It is caused by a persistent infection with a high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) type, influenced by dysbiosis. Identifying the HPV genotypes is the primary step in accurately assessing risk and developing targeted prevention and control strategies. As the HPV vaccine is not a complete protection against all HPV strains that may cause cervical cancer, regular screening is still ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌necessary. Materials and Methods: A cross-sectional study done at a hospital included 150 women of reproductive age presenting with abnormal vaginal discharge. Demographic and reproductive information were collected. Vaginal swabs were analyzed for microbiota using culture and 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq sequencing. Cervical swabs were collected using a liquid-based cytology (LBC) kit for HPV genotyping and cytology. Statistical analysis was performed using t tests, χ2 tests, and k-means cluster analysis; P <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: The prevalence of HR-HPV was 13.33% among women; 3 samples showed multiple-genotype infection. The mean age of women was 39.66 years. The most frequently detected genotypes were HPV 68 and 59. HPV-positive and HSIL samples exhibited increased microbial diversity, including enrichment of anaerobic bacteria such as Gardnerella, Prevotella, and Dialister . Conclusions: In this hospital-based sample of symptomatic women, vaginal dysbiosis was associated with HR-HPV infection, although this finding is limited by the small number of HPV-positive cases. Whether restoring a healthy vaginal microbiota, in combination with genotype-specific HPV vaccination, could reduce the burden of HPV-related disease remains to be tested. Longitudinal and genotype-specific analytical studies are needed to elucidate causal mechanisms and regional variations.

It is caused by a persistent infection with a high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) type, influenced by dysbiosis. Identifying the HPV genotypes is the primary step in accurately assessing risk and developing targeted prevention and control strategies. As the HPV vaccine is not a complete protection against all HPV strains that may cause cervical cancer, regular screening is still ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌necessary. Materials and Methods: A cross-sectional study done at a hospital included 150 women of reproductive age presenting with abnormal vaginal discharge. Demographic and reproductive information were collected. Vaginal swabs were analyzed for microbiota using culture and 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq sequencing. Cervical swabs were collected using a liquid-based cytology (LBC) kit for HPV genotyping and cytology. Statistical analysis was performed using t tests, χ2 tests, and k-means cluster analysis; P Results: The prevalence of HR-HPV was 13.33% among women; 3 samples showed multiple-genotype infection. The mean age of women was 39.66 years. The most frequently detected genotypes were HPV 68 and 59. HPV-positive and HSIL samples exhibited increased microbial diversity, including enrichment of anaerobic bacteria such as Gardnerella, Prevotella, and Dialister . Conclusions: In this hospital-based sample of symptomatic women, vaginal dysbiosis was associated with HR-HPV infection, although this finding is limited by the small number of HPV-positive cases. Whether restoring a healthy vaginal microbiota, in combination with genotype-specific HPV vaccination, could reduce the burden of HPV-related disease remains to be tested. Longitudinal and genotype-specific analytical studies are needed to elucidate causal mechanisms and regional variations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查女性高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 感染与阴道微生物群失调之间的关系,满足更好地了解 HPV 相关疾病机制并制定有针对性的预防策略的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一家医院对 150 名出现阴道分泌物异常的育龄妇女进行了一项横断面研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用培养物和 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq 测序分析阴道拭子的微生物群,同时使用液基细胞学 (LBC) 试剂盒收集宫颈拭子进行 HPV 基因分型和细胞学分析。使用t检验、χ2检验和k均值聚类分析进行统计分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 女性中 HR-HPV 的 患病率 率为 13.33%,其中 HPV 68 和 59 是最常检测到的基因型。HPV 阳性和 HSIL 样本表现出增加的微生物多样性,包括加德纳菌、普雷沃菌和迪亚利斯特菌等厌氧菌的富集。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,阴道生态失调与 HR-HPV 感染有关,尽管这一发现受到 HPV 阳性病例数量较少的限制。作者认为,恢复健康的阴道微生物群,结合基因型特异性 HPV 疫苗接种,可以减轻 HPV 相关疾病的负担。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对阴道微生物群可能是减少 HPV 相关疾病负担的潜在策略,尽管需要进一步的纵向和基因型特异性研究来阐明因果机制和区域差异。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到 HPV 阳性病例数量较少的限制,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。作者建议需要进一步研究来证实这些发现。

abstract_zh: 背景:宫颈癌 仍然是印度女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。它是由高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HR-HPV) 型持续感染引起,并受到菌群失调的影响。识别HPV基因型是准确评估风险、制定针对性防控策略的第一步。由于 HPV 疫苗 并不能完全预防所有可能导致 宫颈癌 的 HPV 毒株,因此定期筛查仍然有必要​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌。材料和方法:一项在医院进行的横断面研究,纳入了 150 名出现阴道分泌物异常的育龄妇女。收集了人口统计和生殖信息。使用培养物和 16S rRNA Illumina MiSeq 测序分析阴道拭子的微生物群。使用液基细胞学 (LBC) 试剂盒收集宫颈拭子,进行 HPV 基因分型和细胞学分析。采用t检验、χ2检验、k均值聚类分析进行统计分析;P<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:女性HR-HPV 患病率率为13.33%;3个样本显示多基因型感染。女性平均年龄为39.66岁。最常检测到的基因型是 HPV 68 和 59。HPV 阳性和 HSIL 样本表现出增加的微生物多样性,包括加德纳菌、普雷沃菌和迪亚利斯特菌等厌氧菌的富集。结论:在这个以医院为基础的有症状女性样本中,阴道生态失调与 HR-HPV 感染相关,尽管这一发现受到 HPV 阳性病例数量较少的限制。恢复健康的阴道微生物群与基因型特异性 HPV 疫苗接种 相结合是否可以减轻 HPV 相关疾病的负担仍有待测试。需要纵向和基因型特异性分析研究来阐明因果机制和区域差异。

title: Temporal trends in cervical cancer screening participation, barriers, HPV infection, and cytopathological profiles before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic in Cameroon
abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer remains a major public health challenge in Cameroon, where screening uptake is limited and access is unequal. This study assessed temporal trends in cervical cancer screening, HPV infection, cytopathological findings, and factors associated with non-participation before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods A serial cross-sectional study included 3,751 women aged 25–65 years recruited from urban and rural health facilities in Cameroon between 2016 and 2024. Sociodemographic, behavioral, sociocultural, healthcare-related, and COVID-19-related data were collected using structured questionnaires. Cervical samples underwent cytological examination using the Bethesda system and HPV genotyping. Temporal patterns were examined across pre-pandemic (2016–2019), pandemic (2020–2021), and post-pandemic (2022–2024) periods. Logistic regression and multiple correspondence analysis were used to identify factors associated with non-participation in screening. Results Screening uptake declined during the pandemic period and subsequently increased, while remaining consistently lower among rural than urban women. HPV prevalence also declined over the study period, with HPV-16 and HPV-18 among the most frequently detected genotypes. LSIL and HSIL were observed in 9.0% and 4.0% of participants, respectively. abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 宫颈癌 仍然是喀麦隆的一项重大公共卫生挑战,该国筛查的普及率有限且获取机会不平等。本研究评估了 宫颈癌 筛查、HPV 感染、细胞病理学结果以及在 COVID-19 大流行之前、期间和之后与不参与相关的因素的时间趋势。方法进行了一项连续横断面研究,纳入 2016 年至 2024 年间从喀麦隆城乡卫生机构招募的 3,751 名 25-65 岁女性。使用结构化问卷收集社会人口、行为、社会文化、医疗保健相关和 COVID-19 相关数据。使用 Bethesda 系统和 HPV 基因分型对宫颈样本进行细胞学检查。对大流行前(2016-2019)、大流行(2020-2021)和大流行后(2022-2024)时期的时间模式进行了检查。使用逻辑回归和多重对应分析来确定与不参与筛查相关的因素。结果 在大流行期间筛查率下降,随后又上升,但农村女性的筛查率始终低于城市女性。HPV 患病率 在研究期间也有所下降,其中 HPV-16 和 HPV-18 是最常检测到的基因型。LSIL 和 HSIL 分别在 9.0% 和 4.0% 的参与者中观察到。不参与与居住在农村、缺乏健康保险、害怕妇科检查、偏爱传统医学以及害怕接触 COVID-19 相关。结论 喀麦隆的 宫颈癌 筛查受到相互关联的地理、社会经济、社会文化和卫生系统障碍的影响。加强分散的、负担得起的、文化上适当的筛查服务至关重要,特别是对于农村和弱势群体而言。

title: Parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against human papillomavirus and associated factors in Injibara Town, Northwest Ethiopia
abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is currently recommended as prevention strategy for cervical cancer. Parental permission is significantly important to increase HPV vaccination coverage among target daughters. This study aimed to assess parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against human papillomavirus and associated factors in Injibara town, Northwest Ethiopia, 2025. A Community-based cross-sectional convergent mixed-methods study was conducted from February 20 to March 20, 2025. For quantitative and qualitative studies, 403 and 12 participants were recruited using simple random and purposive samplings, respectively. An interviewer-administered structured questionnaire tool was used to collect quantitative data. Multi-variable binary logistics regression was employed to identify factors associated with the outcome variable. An adjusted odd ratio with the corresponding 95% confidence interval was used to measure strengths of associations and statistical associations were declared at p-values less than 0.05. Qualitative data were collected using topic guide by in-depth interview technique and were coded, transcribed verbatim, and analysed thematically. The overall parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV was found to be 75.7% (95% CI: 71.2%-79.9%). Daughters’ perceived health status (AOR = 4.51, 95% CI: 2.25-9.00), childhood vaccination (AOR = 2.05, 95% CI: 1.19–3.53), knowledge on HPV (AOR = 2.27, 95% CI: 1.18–4.37), and attitude (AOR = 2.15, 95% CI: 1.23–3.77) were factors associated. Misconceptions on vaccine side effects, information gaps and limited access to additional vaccination sites were barriers of willingness to vaccinate daughters. Approximately three-quarters of parents were willing to vaccinate daughters against HPV which is moderately promising compared with other findings. Daughters’ perceived health status, childhood vaccination, knowledge, and attitude on HPV were significantly associated factors. Qualitative study complemented these findings by revealing misinformation like fear of infertility, inadequate knowledge, and limited access to vaccine sites outside of school-based programs as barriers. The results collectively suggest that parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV could be enhanced through improving parental attitudes and knowledge, addressing myths through reliable means of communication, and expanding vaccination sites outside of school settings.

title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚西北部因吉巴拉镇家长为女儿接种 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗的意愿及相关因素
source_body_en: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination is currently recommended as prevention strategy for cervical cancer. Parental permission is significantly important to increase HPV vaccination coverage among target daughters. This study aimed to assess parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against human papillomavirus and associated factors in Injibara town, Northwest Ethiopia, 2025. A Community-based cross-sectional convergent mixed-methods study was conducted from February 20 to March 20, 2025. For quantitative and qualitative studies, 403 and 12 participants were recruited using simple random and purposive samplings, respectively. An interviewer-administered structured questionnaire tool was used to collect quantitative data. Multi-variable binary logistics regression was employed to identify factors associated with the outcome variable. An adjusted odd ratio with the corresponding 95% confidence interval was used to measure strengths of associations and statistical associations were declared at p-values less than 0.05. Qualitative data were collected using topic guide by in-depth interview technique and were coded, transcribed verbatim, and analysed thematically. The overall parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV was found to be 75.7% (95% CI: 71.2%-79.9%). Daughters’ perceived health status (AOR = 4.51, 95% CI: 2.25-9.00), childhood vaccination (AOR = 2.05, 95% CI: 1.19–3.53), knowledge on HPV (AOR = 2.27, 95% CI: 1.18–4.37), and attitude (AOR = 2.15, 95% CI: 1.23–3.77) were factors associated. Misconceptions on vaccine side effects, information gaps and limited access to additional vaccination sites were barriers of willingness to vaccinate daughters. Approximately three-quarters of parents were willing to vaccinate daughters against HPV which is moderately promising compared with other findings. Daughters’ perceived health status, childhood vaccination, knowledge, and attitude on HPV were significantly associated factors. Qualitative study complemented these findings by revealing misinformation like fear of infertility, inadequate knowledge, and limited access to vaccine sites outside of school-based programs as barriers. The results collectively suggest that parental willingness to vaccinate daughters against HPV could be enhanced through improving parental attitudes and knowledge, addressing myths through reliable means of communication, and expanding vaccination sites outside of school settings.

title: HPV16 transcriptional patterns in oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma with different clinical outcomes
abstract: Abstract Human papillomavirus (HPV) 16 is the leading cause of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) in many Western countries. Although patients with HPV16-positive OPSCC generally have better outcomes than those with HPV-negative disease, significant heterogeneity exists, and a subset of these patients still experience poor prognosis. The contribution of viral gene expression patterns to this heterogeneity remains unclear. In this study, deep RNA sequencing was performed on laser-capture microdissected archival tumor samples from 50 HPV-positive OPSCC patients with known clinical outcomes (29 good prognosis, 21 poor prognosis). RNA sequencing confirmed HPV16 in 40 cases (22 good prognosis, 18 poor prognosis), which were included in the HPV16-specific transcriptional analyses. Residual microbial reads were additionally assessed as a quality-control measure. Higher relative E6 expression and more frequent absence of L1 and E5 transcripts were observed in the poor-prognosis group. These associations were nominally significant in the primary analyses but did not remain statistically significant after false discovery rate correction. In exploratory regression analyses adjusted for advanced nodal stage, higher relative E6 expression and absence of E5 and L1 remained nominally associated with poor prognosis. Sensitivity analysis excluding the 25% of HPV16-positive samples with the lowest total HPV read counts strengthened the observed E6 difference but attenuated the associations for E5 and L1 transcript absence. Overall, this exploratory study identifies HPV16 transcriptional differences between OPSCC tumors from patients with different clinical outcomes. These findings are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger, independent cohorts before prognostic or clinical relevance can be inferred.

abstract_zh: 摘要 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 16 是许多西方国家口咽鳞状细胞癌 (OPSCC) 的主要原因。尽管 HPV16 阳性 OPSCC 患者通常比 HPV 阴性患者有更好的预后,但存在显着的异质性,并且这些患者中的一部分仍然预后不良。病毒基因表达模式对这种异质性的贡献仍不清楚。在这项研究中,对来自 50 名 HPV 阳性 OPSCC 患者的激光捕获显微切割存档肿瘤样本进行了深度 RNA 测序,这些患者的临床结果已知(29 名预后良好,21 名预后不良)。RNA测序证实了40例HPV16(22例预后良好,18例预后不良),这些病例被纳入HPV16特异性转录分析。另外评估残留微生物读数作为质量控制措施。在预后不良组中观察到较高的相对 E6 表达以及更频繁地缺失 L1 和 E5 转录本。这些关联在初步分析中名义上是显着的,但在错误发现率校正后并没有保持统计显着性。在根据晚期淋巴结分期调整的探索性回归分析中,较高的相对 E6 表达以及 E5 和 L1 的缺失名义上仍然与不良预后相关。敏感性分析排除了 25% HPV 总读数最低的 HPV16 阳性样本,加强了观察到的 E6 差异,但减弱了 E5 和 L1 转录本缺失的关联。总体而言,这项探索性研究确定了具有不同临床结果的患者的 OPSCC 肿瘤之间的 HPV16 转录差异。这些发现是假设生成,需要在更大、独立的 队列研究 中进行验证,然后才能推断出预后或临床相关性。

title: Frequency of Human Papillomavirus in Patients Attending Paropakar Maternityand Women’s Hospital, Nepal
abstract: Introduction: Cervical cancer remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in Nepal. Human Papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary etiological factor. This study aimed to determine the frequency of HPV infection among women attending a tertiary care gynecological outpatient department in Kathmandu. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Paropakar Maternity and Women’s Hospital over three months. A total of 185 married or sexually active women aged 30–60 years were enrolled. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV DNA, including high-risk genotypes HPV-16 and HPV-18. Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected. Data analysis was performed using SPSS v26, applying chi-square and ANOVA tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: Of 185 women, 172 (93.0%) were HPV negative. Thirteen (7.0%) tested positive: HPV-16 in 7 (3.8%), HPV-18 in 3 (1.6%), and other types in 3 (1.6%). HPV positivity was more frequent in women aged 50–59 years. We found that postmenopausal women were significantly more likely to have HPV infection than premenopausal women. No significant associations were found with parity, smoking, or age at marriage. Conclusions: HPV was detected in 7%, with HPV-16 being the most common genotype. These findings underscore the importance of strengthening screening and vaccination programs in Nepal.
journal: Journal of Menopause Society of Nepal

This study aimed to determine the frequency of HPV infection among women attending a tertiary care gynecological outpatient department in Kathmandu. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Paropakar Maternity and Women’s Hospital over three months. A total of 185 married or sexually active women aged 30–60 years were enrolled. Cervical samples were collected and tested for HPV DNA, including high-risk genotypes HPV-16 and HPV-18. Sociodemographic and clinical data were collected. Data analysis was performed using SPSS v26, applying chi-square and ANOVA tests, with p < 0.05 considered significant. Results: Of 185 women, 172 (93.0%) were HPV negative. Thirteen (7.0%) tested positive: HPV-16 in 7 (3.8%), HPV-18 in 3 (1.6%), and other types in 3 (1.6%). HPV positivity was more frequent in women aged 50–59 years. We found that postmenopausal women were significantly more likely to have HPV infection than premenopausal women. No significant associations were found with parity, smoking, or age at marriage. Conclusions: HPV was detected in 7%, with HPV-16 being the most common genotype. These findings underscore the importance of strengthening screening and vaccination programs in Nepal.

abstract_zh: 引言:宫颈癌仍然是尼泊尔发病率和死亡率的主要原因。人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒)感染是主要的病因。本研究旨在确定在加德满都三级妇产科门诊就诊的女性中人乳头瘤病毒感染的频率。方法:在帕罗帕卡尔妇产医院进行了为期三个月的横断面研究。共纳入185名30至60岁之间的已婚或有性生活的女性。收集宫颈样本并检测人乳头瘤病毒DNA,包括高危型病毒HPV-16和HPV-18。同时收集了社会人口学和临床数据。使用SPSS v26进行数据分析,采用卡方检验和方差分析,p < 0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果:在185名女性中,172名(93.0%)为HPV阴性。13名(7.0%)为HPV阳性:其中7名(3.8%)为HPV-16阳性,3名(1.6%)为HPV-18阳性,其余3名(1.6%)为其他类型。HPV阳性在50至59岁女性中更为常见。我们发现绝经后女性比绝经前女性更有可能感染HPV。未发现与生育次数、吸烟或初婚年龄有显著关联。结论:7%的女性检测出HPV感染,其中HPV-16是最常见的基因型。这些发现强调了在尼泊尔加强筛查和疫苗接种项目的重要性。

title: Diagnostic accuracy of high-risk HPV DNA and cytology in diagnosing precancerous and early malignant cervical lesions: a protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: Persistent infection with high-risk hr-HPV is a major cause in the aetiopathogenesis of cervical cancer. Early detection by screening is the best strategy for prevention. Two major screening techniques hr-HPV DNA and Pap smear, target the disease condition at two different timepoints in the natural progression of cervical cancer, one at the initial stage and the other at the level of cytological changes, respectively. Our objectives are to determine the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing and compare it with that of Pap smear and co-testing in detecting early cancer lesions. We will search electronic databases, including MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane, and Scopus for studies that reported the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing alone or in combination with Pap in women of any age undergoing cervical cancer screening. We will include studies that evaluated WHO-prequalified HPV-DNA for the detection of precancerous (CIN1–3) and early malignant cervical lesions (FIGO Stage IA) against histopathological examination. Two reviewers will independently screen the eligible articles, and we will assess methodological quality using QUADAS-2 and QUADAS-C. A bivariate model will be used for meta-analysis to estimate summary sensitivity and specificity wherever possible. Certainty of evidence will be assessed using the GRADE approach for diagnostic test accuracy studies. We anticipate biases, challenges, heterogeneity from data, settings, and methods. However, the work aims to provide more information on the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA tests for cervical cancer, supporting evidence-based prevention and early detection strategies. PROSPERO CRD420251251393.

title_zh: 高危型HPV DNA 和细胞学在诊断癌前和早期恶性宫颈病变中的诊断准确性:系统评价和荟萃分析方案
source_body_en: Persistent infection with high-risk hr-HPV is a major cause in the aetiopathogenesis of cervical cancer. Early detection by screening is the best strategy for prevention. Two major screening techniques hr-HPV DNA and Pap smear, target the disease condition at two different timepoints in the natural progression of cervical cancer, one at the initial stage and the other at the level of cytological changes, respectively. Our objectives are to determine the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing and compare it with that of Pap smear and co-testing in detecting early cancer lesions. We will search electronic databases, including MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane, and Scopus for studies that reported the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA testing alone or in combination with Pap in women of any age undergoing cervical cancer screening. We will include studies that evaluated WHO-prequalified HPV-DNA for the detection of precancerous (CIN1–3) and early malignant cervical lesions (FIGO Stage IA) against histopathological examination. Two reviewers will independently screen the eligible articles, and we will assess methodological quality using QUADAS-2 and QUADAS-C. A bivariate model will be used for meta-analysis to estimate summary sensitivity and specificity wherever possible. Certainty of evidence will be assessed using the GRADE approach for diagnostic test accuracy studies. We anticipate biases, challenges, heterogeneity from data, settings, and methods. However, the work aims to provide more information on the diagnostic accuracy of hr-HPV DNA tests for cervical cancer, supporting evidence-based prevention and early detection strategies. PROSPERO CRD420251251393.

title: Parents perceptions and acceptability of the human papillomavirus vaccine in rural Zambia: a descriptive phenomenological study at Kabompo Hospital Affiliated Health Centre
abstract: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer death among women in Zambia, and vaccination of girls aged 9-14 years against human papillomavirus (HPV) is the principal primary prevention strategy. Because the vaccine is given to minors, uptake depends on parental consent, which is shaped by how parents perceive the vaccine. In Kabompo, a rural, ethnically diverse district of North-Western Province, only 59% of eligible girls had been vaccinated by 2024, well below the global target, yet no qualitative evidence existed on how parents in such settings understand and decide about the vaccine. We conducted a descriptive phenomenological study at Kabompo Hospital Affiliated Health Centre between June and August 2025. Twenty parents and legal guardians of girls aged 9-14 years were purposively selected using maximum variation sampling and interviewed in depth in English or Luvale. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim and analysed using Colaizzi's seven-step method with QDA Miner Lite. Five themes were generated: knowledge and awareness of HPV and its vaccine; perceptions of safety and efficacy; sociocultural and religious influences; the role of health workers; and barriers to access. Most parents knew the vaccine prevents cervical cancer, but few could explain how HPV causes cancer or state the schedule, and several first learned about the vaccine at the point of service. Fear of infertility was the most prominent concern, alongside unease that the vaccine was too new. Religious framings of divine protection, preference for herbal remedies, and concern that vaccination condones early sexual activity shaped decisions. Health workers were the most trusted source of information and were often decisive. Distance, transport costs, fear of injections and incomplete dosing limited uptake. Stated acceptability was high but did not consistently translate into vaccination, indicating an intention-behaviour gap that information campaigns alone are unlikely to close.

title_zh: 赞比亚农村地区家长对 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗 的看法和接受度:卡邦波医院附属健康中心的描述性现象学研究
source_body_en: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer death among women in Zambia, and vaccination of girls aged 9-14 years against human papillomavirus (HPV) is the principal primary prevention strategy. Because the vaccine is given to minors, uptake depends on parental consent, which is shaped by how parents perceive the vaccine. In Kabompo, a rural, ethnically diverse district of North-Western Province, only 59% of eligible girls had been vaccinated by 2024, well below the global target, yet no qualitative evidence existed on how parents in such settings understand and decide about the vaccine. We conducted a descriptive phenomenological study at Kabompo Hospital Affiliated Health Centre between June and August 2025. Twenty parents and legal guardians of girls aged 9-14 years were purposively selected using maximum variation sampling and interviewed in depth in English or Luvale. Interviews were audio-recorded, transcribed verbatim and analysed using Colaizzi's seven-step method with QDA Miner Lite. Five themes were generated: knowledge and awareness of HPV and its vaccine; perceptions of safety and efficacy; sociocultural and religious influences; the role of health workers; and barriers to access. Most parents knew the vaccine prevents cervical cancer, but few could explain how HPV causes cancer or state the schedule, and several first learned about the vaccine at the point of service. Fear of infertility was the most prominent concern, alongside unease that the vaccine was too new. Religious framings of divine protection, preference for herbal remedies, and concern that vaccination condones early sexual activity shaped decisions. Health workers were the most trusted source of information and were often decisive. Distance, transport costs, fear of injections and incomplete dosing limited uptake. Stated acceptability was high but did not consistently translate into vaccination, indicating an intention-behaviour gap that information campaigns alone are unlikely to close.
